title: My Shepherd Will Supply My Need
lyrics: And [G]leads me, [D/F#]for His [C]mercy's [Em]sake, In [C]paths of [D]truth and [G]grace.
When [G]I walk [D/F#]through the [C]shades of [Em]death, Thy [C]presence [D]is my [G]stay;
Thy [Em]hand in [D/F#]sight of [C]all my [D]foes Doth [Em]still my [D/F#]table [C]spread,
O [G]may Thy [D/F#]house be [C]mine [Em]abode And [C]all my [D]work be [G]praise.
No [G]more a [D/F#]stranger [C]or a [Em]guest, But [C]like a [D]child at [G]home.
